Recommendation: Approve and authorize the Mayor to execute an agreement to join the statewide emergency response and mutual aid group, California Water/Wastewater Agency Response Network (CALWARN).

Recommendation: Approve and authorize the Mayor and the Director of Utilities to execute an agreement to join the local emergency response and mutual aid group, Water Emergency Response of Los Angeles County (WERLAC).

Waive Formal Bidding Procedures due to Sole Source and Award Purchase of Terex PT70 Compact Track Loader to RGW Equipment Company. Recommendation: Waive formal bidding procedures due to sole source and award purchase of Terex PT70 Compact Track Loader to RGW Equipment for the DeskinsT Sludge Dewatering Retrofit Project W-281 at the Hsu-Canyon Water Treatment Plant in the amount of $78,469.99.
